integrity.computational_basis: Standard-library exact verifier; exhaustive full graph profiles for orders one to seven and full closed formula to order eight.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact joint fixed-degree-one count, Walsh expansion, conditional one-vertex argument and uniform probability estimates.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claims beyond the specified graph model and norms.

scientific_limitations: Only simple uniformly sampled labelled graphs with independent fair edges, not arbitrary random graph models or edge probabilities.
Complete spectrum and optimal Euclidean conditioning, but no endpoint inverse-norm classification.
Historical priority is bounded by accessible literature and semantic search; unindexed equivalent signed joint-degree identities remain possible.
title: Exact Fourier recovery from degree-one vertices of dense labelled graphs
